title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
summary: On the morning of 7 December 1941, carrier-launched aircraft of the Imperial Japanese Navy executed a surprise aerial attack against the United States Pacific Fleet anchored at Pearl Harbor on Oahu, Hawaii. The raid sank or damaged eight battleships, destroyed nearly two hundred aircraft, and killed over 2,400 Americans. The devastating assault abruptly shattered American isolationism, prompting Congress to declare war on Japan the following day and precipitating German and Italian declarations of war that unified World War II across the Pacific and Atlantic.
